title: Three parity factors under coordinatewise conjunction
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $S\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}$ be a set of coordinates. Choose sign vectors $x,y\in\{\pm1\}^n$ independently and uniformly, and let $x\wedge y$ be their coordinatewise Boolean conjunction, equal to $-1$ exactly where both signs are $-1$. The expected product of the three parity values on $x$, $y$, and $x\wedge y$ is $(-\frac12)^{|S|}$.
